full_name: Stephen J. Shoemaker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Stephen J. Shoemaker, a professor of religious studies at the University of Oregon, is a specialist on the history of ancient and early medieval Christianity and early Islam.
